name: AI Training Assistant evaluation dataset
description: Synthetic new-employee questions for evaluating routing accuracy and answer faithfulness. Reference chunk text is copied verbatim from the Markdown corpus in data/ and is checked against it by tests/test_faithfulness.py::test_reference_chunks_match_corpus, so it cannot drift silently.

routes.company: General company questions -> company overview knowledge base
routes.role: Role-specific questions -> role and team documents
routes.general: Anything else -> direct LLM response, no retrieval

routing_questions.question: What does Manna's Analytics do as a business?

reference_chunks.citation: Manna's Analytics - Company Overview > Who we are
reference_chunks.text:
Manna's Analytics is a B2B software company that helps mid-market and enterprise
customers turn operational data into decisions. Our platform ingests data from
warehouses, SaaS tools and event streams, then delivers governed metrics,
anomaly alerts and embedded dashboards to business teams.

We were founded in **2017** in Bengaluru by **Ananya Rao** and **Vikram Iyer**
after they spent years building internal reporting tools at a logistics company
and grew tired of every team maintaining its own conflicting version of the
same number.

routing_questions.notes: Asks what the company does. The founding year is in the same source chunk but is not part of a correct answer to this question, so it is not required.

routing_questions.question: When do new engineers join the on-call rotation?

reference_chunks.citation: Engineering - Team Charter and Role Guide > On-call
reference_chunks.text:
- Every group runs a weekly rotation, one primary and one secondary.
- New engineers join the rotation **after** their first 90 days and only after
  shadowing two full rotations.
- Severity definitions and the RCA process are documented in the Platform
  runbooks. A Sev-1 or Sev-2 requires a written RCA within five working days.
- On-call compensation: a weekly on-call allowance plus time-off-in-lieu for any
  night-time page, claimed through the leave system as "On-call TOIL".

routing_questions.question: What are the performance rating levels?

reference_chunks.citation: Career Framework, Grades and Performance > Rating scale
reference_chunks.text:
| Rating | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Exceptional | Consistently operating a full grade above expectations |
| Exceeds | Delivered clearly beyond the expectations of the grade |
| Meets | Delivered what the grade expects; this is a good, healthy rating |
| Developing | Below expectation in some areas; a written development plan follows |
| Not meeting | Sustained shortfall; a formal performance improvement plan follows |

Roughly two thirds of employees land on **Meets** in a normal cycle. "Meets" is
not a warning sign, and managers are coached to say so explicitly.

routing_questions.question: How long is typical time in grade before a promotion?

reference_chunks.citation: Career Framework, Grades and Performance > Promotion
reference_chunks.text:
Promotion is a recognition that you are **already** operating at the next grade
consistently, not a reward for tenure or a bet on potential.

- Nominated by your functional manager, evidenced by a written case with examples.
- Calibrated across the function so the bar is consistent between managers.
- L6 and above additionally reviewed by the function's executive sponsor.
- Typical time in grade before promotion: 18 to 30 months at L3-L5, longer above.

routing_questions.question: I clicked a phishing link. What should I do?

reference_chunks.citation: Compliance and Information Security Policy > 7. Phishing and social engineering
reference_chunks.text:
- Report suspected phishing with the **Report Phish** button in your mail client.
  Do not forward it to colleagues.
- Manna's runs unannounced simulated phishing campaigns. Clicking a simulation
  results in a short training module, not disciplinary action.
- Verify any unusual request about payments, credentials or urgency **out of band**
  through a known channel. Executive-impersonation fraud is the most common attack
  we see. No genuine Manna's process ever asks you to bypass a control because
  something is urgent.

reference_chunks.citation: Compliance and Information Security Policy > 8. Incident reporting
reference_chunks.text:
**Report immediately, and always within 1 hour of noticing, even if you are not
sure it is real:**

- Post in `#security-incidents` **and** email `security@mannasanalytics.example`.
- For a lost or stolen device, also call the 24x7 InfoSec line listed in the IT
  Handbook so the device can be remotely wiped.

Report: lost or stolen devices, suspected malware, an email you clicked and then
doubted, data sent to the wrong recipient, an exposed credential, unexpected
access you seem to have, or a customer telling you they can see data that is not
theirs.

**You will never be penalised for reporting an incident you caused.** Delay causes
far more damage than the original mistake, and our regulatory notification clocks
start when Manna's becomes aware.

Severity and escalation, including the 72-hour regulatory notification assessment
under GDPR, are handled by the InfoSec on-call and Privacy Counsel.

routing_questions.question: How do I report harassment without telling my manager?

reference_chunks.text:
If something looks wrong, raise it. You will not be penalised for raising a
concern in good faith, even if it turns out to be unfounded.

| Route | Use for |
| --- | --- |
| Your manager | Most day-to-day concerns |
| Your People Partner | Interpersonal issues, conduct concerns |
| Internal Committee (`ic-committee@mannasanalytics.example`) | Sexual harassment |
| `#security-incidents` and `security@mannasanalytics.example` | Security and data incidents |
| Legal (`#ask-legal`) | Bribery, conflicts, competition law, insider information |
| Ethics Line (`ethics.mannasanalytics.example`) | Anything, anonymously, 24x7, run by an independent third party |

The Ethics Line is available in English, Hindi, Kannada and German and does not
capture identifying metadata. Reports go to the General Counsel and, where the
report concerns the General Counsel or an exec team member, directly to the Audit
Committee of the board.

reference_chunks.citation: Code of Conduct > 1. Treat people well > India-specific: prevention of sexual harassment
reference_chunks.text:
Manna's complies with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention,
Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013. An **Internal Committee (IC)** is
constituted with an external member. Complaints may be made directly to the IC at
`ic-committee@mannasanalytics.example`, bypassing any manager. The IC acknowledges
within 3 working days and completes inquiry within 90 days.
